# ONNX Runtime LSTM fixtures

The binary fixtures in this directory are generated by
`tools/generate_ort_fixtures.py` with the official ONNX Runtime 1.27.0 Python
package and `CPUExecutionProvider`. Graph optimization is disabled and both
thread counts are pinned to one. Each adjacent JSON file records the complete
operator contract, tool versions, and SHA-256 digest.

The fixture header is little-endian `<8s6I`: magic `KORLSTM1`, format version,
sequence length, input width, and the element counts of `Y`, `Y_h`, and `Y_c`.
The header is followed by those three contiguous little-endian float32 arrays.

Regenerate with the pinned environment:

```sh
/tmp/trueos-kokoro-lstm-ort127/bin/python \
  crates/trueos-kokoro/lstm/tools/generate_ort_fixtures.py
```

The same fixtures can be cross-checked without rewriting provenance against a
second runtime with `--verify`. The local custom/pre-release ONNX Runtime
1.28.0 environment produced bit-identical `Y`, `Y_h`, and `Y_c` values for all
4,608 fixture floats.
